sections.markdown:
## B — Audience and scope

Audience: first-time Connecticut applicants preparing in English for the Class D knowledge test; this section matters most to adults facing the road test, to sixteen- and seventeen-year-olds and their parents learning the teen restrictions, and to applicants with medical conditions exploring limited licenses.
Level: plain-English reading level; no prior driving vocabulary is assumed, so each manual term is defined where it first appears.
Prerequisites: the learner permit and knowledge test path from the prior section; this section continues chapter one.
Section scope: manual chapter one, second part: adult applicants, road test knowledge and scoring, license payment, teen passenger and curfew restrictions, organ and tissue donation, voter registration, and disability driving services.
Out of scope: commercial and motorcycle licensing detail, vehicle equipment, driving maneuvers, fees beyond those printed here, and anything not printed on the selected manual pages.

corpus_stability.reason: The Connecticut Driver’s Manual is one dated edition (Revised March 2023, physical p3); nothing on the selected pages indicates more than one rewrite per year.
